# Class: `RangeLimitDelegate`

Displays available endpoints as placeholders in temperature-limit cells.

[Module](API-Module-icescopy-inptk-panel.md) | [Source](../src/icescopy_inptk_panel.py#L56) | [API index](API-Reference.md)

**Bases:** `QStyledItemDelegate`.

Uses the cell's user-role text when no explicit limit is set. The placeholder does not become an analysis cutoff when the editor opens.
